caption: Release budget and the coverage it buys. (a) Fraction of Timing OFF exchanges whose measured interval exceeds a given value, per transaction class, with the chosen budget $D$ and the fail-open horizon $H$ marked. (b) Fraction of Timing OFF exchanges the switch cannot place on the schedule, against the release budget. At $D$ = 24 ms, 30 of 31680 exchanges (0.0947%) arrive too late to be held. Both ordinates are logarithmic; panel (a) also uses a logarithmic abscissa and shows the full support.

notes.measured_vs_modelled: both panels are measured; no model is fitted
